mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish: current conditions at Reddan Soccer Park are clear with a temperature of 53 degrees. We are currently under a new moon phase, and tonight's low will reach 38 degrees with no rain in the forecast.

The city is moving forward with the Mark Drive reconstruction project. This phase includes updating water and sewer utilities and adding new concrete sidewalks between Nine Mound Road and Westlawn Avenue, with tree planting to follow construction.

Yoga at Insight Wellness is happening today. Looking ahead, you have plenty of options with trivia events tomorrow at Hop Haus, Wisconsin Brewing Company, and Paddy Mac's, plus live music at Paddy Mac's tomorrow.
In our weekly look at local reports, on October 25, police responded to a report of a vehicle stopped for twenty minutes at Plympton Street and Rita Avenue, resulting in an arrest for O W I.
You can enjoy the flavor of the day, Caramel Fudge Cookie Dough, at our local Culver's, which is currently open and serving guests until 10:00 PM.
